'''Alnora''' was a female [[Da'shain Aiel]] during the [[Breaking]]. She was a [[dreamer]] and wife of [[Jonai]].

==Appearance==
She had shoulder length glossy black hair.

{{Ancestry/Rand}}

==History and Family==
She was a dreamwalker. She helped Jonai with her dreams which direction to go and what to do after they have left [[Paaran Disen|Paaren Disen]] with the ten thousand Da'shain Aiel. Alnora and Jonai had three children, [[Willim]], age of fifteen when they have left Paaren Disen, [[Adan]], age of ten, and [[Esole]] the youngest. 

She died under unknown circumstances but it is indicated that an Aes Sedai could have Healed her, but none was traveling with them. {{ref/book|4|26}}

==Errata==
She is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until the time of her great-grandson [[Lewin]]. She should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref|{{twotc}},Alnora}}
